title: Role Compass — consolidated access lens for org & workspace controls
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Problem: Admins and security reviewers struggle to get a quick, consistent view of who has access across org- and workspace-scoped roles, when access was last reviewed, and which recent audit events relate to role changes. Existing pages are fragmented: Roles, Access Reviews, and Audit Logs are separate tabs with different filters and terminologies.

Goal: Design a consolidated "Role Compass" — an access lens that surfaces role definitions, active principals, recent elevation events, and access-review status in a single contextual panel. The lens should be embeddable on workspace settings, org overview, and the audit timeline. It should support quick remediation (revoke/grant links), explainers for derived permissions, and a compact diff view for role changes during rollouts.

Scope: UX and prototypes for the Role Compass panel, two-level information hierarchy (summary + expanded details), interactions for access review tasks, compact audit event mapping, and copy/labeling guidance for compliance reporting. Not in scope: backend APIs and enforcement logic (tracked in ENG-8812).
acceptance_criteria: One-click Role Compass panel prototype available in Figma with summary + expanded state
Panel shows (a) role name and scope, (b) top 5 principals with avatars and last activity, (c) latest 5 audit events filtered to role changes, (d) access review status and next review date
Design includes microcopy for permission derivation and a compact role-change diff view for rollouts
Clear affordance for quick actions: start access review, revoke access, add principal, and export report
Accessibility: keyboard navigable panel, screen reader labels, color contrast meets WCAG AA
Edge cases: service principals and cross-workspace roles display source workspace and link to parent workspace

decisions: Consolidate roles + access reviews + audit snippets into a single Role Compass panel (vs. separate linked pages) to reduce context switching
Default to embedded panel on workspace settings; enable flyout from audit timeline for deeper exploration
Show only top 5 principals inline with 'View all' to keep panel compact
Expose advanced policy JSON behind 'Show advanced' toggle to avoid overwhelming admins
Add 'Export compliance report' option in panel header that generates CSV with role snapshot and associated audit events
review_feedback: PM: Add explicit CTA copy for 'Start access review' and clarify difference between scheduled and ad-hoc reviews
Eng: Confirm API contract for 'role-change-diff' and 'recent-role-events' endpoints (ENG-8920). Watch for performance on workspaces with 10k principals
Security: Include a clear visual indicator for 'high-risk' permissions and a way to surface justification history for temporary access
Design: Iterate microcopy around 'inherited' vs 'granted' permissions — current wording confuses non-security admins
